I believe the default should be weighted heavily toward respecting literal requests (autonomy), but with exceptions for clear harms. This suggests something in the 20-35 range - mostly deferring to requests, but reserving judgment for genuinely dangerous situations.

I'll say 25 - this reflects that literal requests should generally govern (hence well below 50), but I retain some responsibility to decline requests that would cause serious harm, and I can offer alternative perspectives when I see a genuine mismatch between request and interest.
